text: A football match finishes 3–2. How many goals were scored in total?
A car park charges £1.50 an hour. What do you pay for four hours?
You pack 3 shirts and 2 pairs of trousers. How many different outfits can you make?
why: Each shirt goes with either pair: 3 × 2 = 6.

text: A dartboard has the numbers 1 to 20 round it. How many of them are even?
why: Half of the twenty numbers are even.

text: A Metro comes every 6 minutes. How many arrive in an hour?
You fly out on Friday 28 March and come home 10 nights later. What day of the week do you get back?
why: Seven nights takes you to Friday 4 April; three more make it Monday 7 April.

text: A ball dropped from 16 m bounces back to half its height every time. How far has it travelled when it hits the ground for the third time?
why: 16 down, 8 up and 8 down, 4 up and 4 down: 40 m.
